description: A plumber and a retired clerk: geyser not heating. The geyser's age and brand are not the work; the visit charge is bargained, complained about, and agreed at 650; a heating element is priced and put off; a one-month free redo is the late term.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Namaste uncle, Irfan bol raha hoon, plumber. Geyser ka bola tha aapne?

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Haan Irfan. Bathroom wala geyser garam hi nahi kar raha. Racold ka hai, chhe saal purana.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Thermostat ya element hoga. Aake dekhna padega. Visit aur thermostat badalne ka 800 lagega.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: 800 to bahut zyada hai bhai, pichhli baar 500 mein kiya tha kisi ne.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Uncle naya thermostat hi 400 ka aata hai. Chaliye 650 kar dijiye.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Theek hai, 650. Kal subah aa jaoge?

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Haan kal subah das baje tak aa jaunga. Agar element bhi jala hua nikla to 1,200 alag lagega.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: 1,200 wala baad mein dekhenge, pehle thermostat lagao.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Theek hai uncle. Aur ek mahine mein phir se band hua to free mein theek karunga.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Achha, ye sahi hai. Paise kaam ke baad cash dunga.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Ji uncle, koi baat nahi. Kal milte hain.
